capabilities: save the scroll position of each note
restore the saved position when a note is reopened
trigger restore manually via ribbon icon or command
extras: README lists limitations: does not work in read view (only Live Preview and Source), the saved position is an estimate rather than exact, and mobile is untested and probably unsupported.
motivation: The author built it to support their personal workflow of continuing to read long notes.
problem: Obsidian always opens notes scrolled to the top, which is inconvenient for long notes you are reading over multiple sessions.
summary: Saves each note's scroll position and restores it when you reopen the note, so you return to where you left off.
